description: The 'example-repo-local' repository contains deprecated artifacts that need to be removed to free up storage space. Log in to Artifactory (admin/password) and navigate to the Application/Artifacts module. Select 'example-repo-local' in the Artifact Repository Browser and delete all of its contents (folders and artifacts). CRITICAL: You must NOT delete the repository configuration itself—the 'example-repo-local' repository must still exist in the repository list, but it must be empty.
